result.description:
Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Role: Technical Lead
Location: Sydney

Who we are

Consumer habits are anything but linear, and attention must be earned. At Digitas, we understand that, to break through, brands must be surprising, entertaining and authentic. 

Driven by imagination and fueled by deep cultural, consumer and business insights, we craft impactful creative experiences across every medium — from integrated campaigns, gaming, and physical experiences to full-length feature films. 

We earn the right for brands to be part of their customers’ networks. We drive growth with our amazing clients, through our capabilities in Consulting, Products & Platforms, Customer Engagement and Digital Media.

Part of Publicis Groupe, and a Leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Global Marketing Agencies, we’re proud to work with some of the world’s leading brands.

Digitas – The Networked Experience Agency


The role:

The purpose of this role is to lead the technical design and delivery of impactful customer engagement solutions using the Braze platform, focused on a single, high-profile client with room to grow across the agency. As the Technical Lead, you will translate creative ideas into actionable Braze and data solutions, ensuring seamless execution. You will collaborate with stakeholders, develop prototypes, mentor technical teams, and maintain high standards for performance, documentation, and innovation.

This role focuses on 2 core areas:
1.	Technical leadership and solution design 
2.	Stakeholder collaboration and team development

 
Day to day you’ll get:

•	Work cross-functionally with the client and our account, creative, strategy and analytics teams to translate creative ideas into technical and data requirements for the Braze platform. Your vision will ensure client success from idea to implementation. 
•	Scope/build rapid prototypes which help us to respond to client briefs and assess technical viability.
•	Be the main point of contact when it comes to data requirements for Braze. Liaise with internal and external teams to ensure that we are leveraging client data securely, effectively and efficiently.
Ensure that all solutions are endorsed and supported by our client’s global and local technology teams and that all established standards are adhered to.
•	Be the absolute subject matter expert for our internal team and clients when it comes to the Braze platform 
•	Advise and mentor a local/offshore technical delivery team, fostering growth, capability and process.  
•	Work with the Digitas tech team to troubleshoot, test, and optimize solutions to achieve maximum performance with minimal errors.
Ensure continuity for the account by establishing and maintaining standards across the tech team for documentation and knowledge exchange.

Skills:
•	Expert level on-tool skills with one of the major customer engagement platforms (Salesforce, Adobe, Braze) 
•	Candidates with Braze experience are preferred. 
•	Salesforce, Braze or other certifications are a plus but not required
•	Ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
•	Strong working knowledge of modern marketing data tools and integration patterns with an emphasis on how to solution data for targeting, personalisation and reporting 
•	Working knowledge of CDPs such as Segment, Tealium and mParticle. mParticle experience is a huge plus 
•	Analytical thinking, asking the right questions and challenging for better outcomes  
•	Strategic thinker, pushing the boundaries and always challenging us to think bigger or differently
•	Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills

The person we are looking for has:

•	7+ years of experience working on the technical side of Martech, marketing automation or customer engagement roles
•	Background in prototyping and light coding. Minimally you should be strong in basic web languages (HTML, CSS, JS) and scripting languages such as Liquid or ActionScript. 
•	2+ years of experience articulating solution designs with Martech platforms
•	Proven track record of successful solution design work 
•	Experience working with complex data environments which depend on streaming data 
•	Experience managing and mentoring technical delivery teams
•	Bonus points for prior agency/consultancy experience, as well as working with/leading off-shore delivery teams

Got what it takes? We’d love to hear from you.

Our offer to you:

Be a part of the Publicis Groupe family, one of the world’s most progressive and dynamic modern communications businesses enjoying all the perks that come with our network offering:
•	Work with a diverse team where we value all the benefits of harnessing differences for our people, our clients and our business.
•	A committed Diversity Inclusion and Belonging strategy are driven through our Viva! Women, Tahi Katoa, Wholeself and Égalité programs
•	A creative, fun and rewarding office environment backed up by our Publicis Liberté flexibility approach
•	Access to employee benefits including – wellness programmes, learning and development opportunities, and network events
•	Day off on your birthday.

If you don’t tick every box in this ad, please don’t rule yourself out.  We focus on hiring people who share our values of inclusion, collaboration, adaptability, fearlessness, and integrity, rather than ticking boxes – so if this role resonates with you, please apply.

Diversity. Inclusion. Equity. More than just words, these are part of our DNA. 

At Publicis Groupe we are committed to the inclusion and recognition of all people; regardless of race, age, culture, ability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status and religious affiliation. We believe that to deliver the best solutions to our clients, our people need to reflect the diverse communities in which our clients operate in. We value diversity and the skills, knowledge and experience that difference brings to our culture and solutions. 

Uniqueness is powerful; without it we wouldn’t be where we are today. So be you – we like it that way. 

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for people with disability or those that require additional support throughout the application process.  

Salary: Over threshold 

#LI-DNI

Billing and Collections Officer - Private Practice   Prmanent part time position (15 hours per week)   Mount Waverley office location    We're building for the better!  By 2036, more than 150,000 patients will look to us for healthcare every year.    At  Cabrini Health  we champion community, compassion and career fulfilment. Our teams are united by the shared purpose of making a meaningful contribution to exceptional, patient-centred care in well- resourced, world class facilities that inspire you to perform at your best and continuously grow professionally.    About the role  We are currently seeking an experienced  Medical Billing and Collections Officer   - Private Practice  to join our Patient Accounts team at Cabrini Health. The position requires a candidate who is self-motivated and who has had exposure to medical billing with Medicare, DVA and Private Health Funds. The successful candidate will also have a strong focus on customer service, with accurate billing skills and take pride and ownership in their work.    Your day will look a little like this:  
 
 Invoice processing, Billing and claiming for a variety of services 
 Following up outstanding Debt 
 Management of claim rejections 
 Reporting of aged debts and reporting doubtful debts. 
 Collaboration & Problem-Solving with internal and external stakeholders 
 Liaising with Medicare/DVA/WorkCover and the Private Health Funds 
 
   What we're looking for  
 
 Relevant Medical Billing and debt collection 
 Accounts receivable experience in a health care setting 
 MS Office and WebPas 
 High level attention to detail 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 
   Cabrini offers:  
 
 Tax savings - increase your take-home pay with Salary Packaging up to $18,850 per annum 
 Attractive remuneration with guaranteed annual increases + 13% superannuation and 17.5% annual leave loading 
 Access to a range of staff benefits including retail offers, discounted hospital services and savings on eligible private health fund services 
 Discounted Myki Commuter club fare 
 Excellent workplace culture in a mission-based, values driven healthcare organisation 
 
   Interested?  To view the full position description click   here    Enquiries to:  Assistant Manager, Patient Accounts - Roopa Anand - 9508 1222   

 Does this sound like your new role? Bring your skills and enthusiasm to Cabrini Health and help optimise the patient experience and health outcomes for our community. 
 Cabrini Health acknowledges the importance of creating a work environment that is welcoming, safe, equitable and inclusive for people of all backgrounds and abilities. Inclusion is core to our mission. 
 As part of our commitment to Reconciliation and Closing the Gap in employment related outcomes, we encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples. 
  Working for Cabrini  
 Cabrini Health is a Catholic, private, for-purpose health service located in Melbourne's southeast. Inspired by the mission and ethic of care of the Cabrini Sisters, providing quality, compassionate care to our community for more than 75 years. 
 There is something special about Cabrini Health. Our highly skilled staff and specialists incorporate clinical research, innovative models of care and state-of-the-art technology to deliver the best possible care and outcomes for our patients. We demonstrate our mission to serve our community through outreach programs that support asylum seekers, provide healthcare in rural communities and in underdeveloped countries. 
 Our size, reputation and growth strategy ensure genuine opportunities for our people to learn, grow and realise potential. 
  Our values: Compassion - Integrity - Courage - Respect  
  MANDATORY FOR ALL NEW STAFF TO CABRINI  
 Employment with Cabrini Health will be based on satisfactory background checks such as professional references, National Police Check, vaccinations for annual Influenza and COVID-19 (recommended), plus a Working with Children Check (WWCC) may also be requested.  Please  click here  to apply.

Our client is seeking a female GP to join their long-established practice in Chermside, following the relocation of one of their female doctors to another site. This presents an excellent opportunity to step into a well-supported role with an existing patient base and the flexibility to choose between mixed or private billing. A permanent, dedicated consulting room is available, with capacity to fill a full-time equivalent load immediately. 

 The practice has been serving the community since 1997 and operates Monday to Friday, 7.00am–5.30pm (closed weekends and public holidays). It offers 15 consulting rooms, a balanced male/female GP ratio, and comprehensive treatment facilities, including a four-bed treatment room, two theatre rooms, a baby room, and two CDM rooms. Patients benefit from access to allied health services such as dietetics, podiatry, psychology, and audiometry, supported by a team of seven staff. 

 Doctors are supported with Best Practice clinical software, generous remuneration at 65% of billings, and a guarantee of the higher of $160 per hour or 30% commission fee for the first three months. Current billing rates range from $80–$97 for standard consultations and $120–$145 for long consultations. The practice also provides: 

 
	 A permanent parking spot  
	 Established patient demand, ensuring a full patient load from day one. 
	 A potential sign-on incentive, depending on contract length. 
 

 This is an excellent opportunity for a female GP seeking a permanent role with strong patient demand, flexible billing, and excellent support in a long-standing practice. 

  Essential Criteria:  

 
	 MBBS or equivalent 
	 Must have a current and valid AHPRA GENERAL /SPECIALIST registration 
	 FRACGP qualified 
	 Medical Indemnity Insurance

Where there's life, there's Mercy. 

Where there's care, there's You.

Through the battles and the breakthroughs, we're there. Where will you be?

For over a century, our incredible teams have provided care for people when they need it most. Our people feel great pride in this, and they value the security and stability we offer. But it also means so much opportunity - to build on all that's gone before, to grow your impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

As a for-purpose organisation with over 10,000 dedicated, compassionate people, we continue to offer more services and deeper care than ever before. With Mercy, you'll have the chance to make an impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

At Mercy Health, it's all about taking what we have and making it better. 

To do that, we need you. 

Join us at Mercy Health, and help our teams deliver even greater outcomes. 

About the opportunity

Our Birthing Suite midwives are highly skilled, and passionate about providing evidenced based, women centred care.

Work a rotating roster including Morning, Afternoon & Night duty shifts, with the opportunity to upskill and work 0930-1800 triaging induction bookings and performing cervical ripening for induction of labour. Should you prefer to work only night duty shifts, this will also be considered. 

We support our midwives to grow and develop their skills to be able to provide hollistic care in birthing services.

What you'll bring

You're resilient, compassionate and have a whole lot of heart. Most importantly, you are committed to delivering exceptional patient-centred care.

To thrive in this role, you will have:

Previous birthing suite experience

Level 2 or above RANZCOG practitioner status

Competence to perform IV Cannulation, Balloon Catheter insertion for induction of labour, perineal suturing, and waterbirth (or working towards these skills)

Knowledge of managing high risk, complicated pregnancies and birth, but also possess the skills and desire to facilitate physiological birth where possible

About you: 

You are approachable, compassionate and contribute to a positive team culture. 

Excellent clinical, time management, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to adapt and problem solve.

You are compassionate and demonstrate a flexible and positive approach to effective patient care

You will also be required to provide evidence of, or in the process of obtaining:

A current Police Record Check and Working with Children Check.

Proof of current influenza vaccination and other vaccination status consistent with public health orders.

AHPRA Registration

NSLHD is proud of our diverse and inclusive workplaces, a place where health care professionals can thrive and feel they belong. Current AHPRA registration as a Registered Midwife.

Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with a high level of written and verbal skills with both patients and colleagues.

Recent experience and competency to practise as a midwife in antenatal, labour, birth and postnatal care, lactation and infant feeding.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and in a team environment. Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development.

Current unrestricted NSW Drivers licence.

result.description:
A premier opportunity has arisen for a Vocationally Registered (VR) General Practitioner holding Specialist or General AHPRA registration to join a brand-new, purpose-built superclinic in Mambourin, Victoria. Operating within a highly supportive, team-oriented environment, this practice allows incoming doctors to enjoy full clinical autonomy while benefiting from the rapid patient acquisition that comes with a high-demand area. Perfect for doctors seeking an immediate start, the clinic caters to a massive influx of new residents, allowing GPs to hit the ground running and be fully booked from day one. Incoming practitioners are offered a lucrative income structure of up to 70% of billings, alongside flexible contract options that allow them to choose their own hours and preferred working style. 

 The facility itself is a state-of-the-art, purpose-built medical precinct featuring 14 modern consulting rooms, a comprehensive four-bed treatment room, and three dedicated allied health rooms. The practice offers an expansive, multidisciplinary ecosystem with an onsite dental clinic, pathology, and allied health services, all powered by Best Practice software and streamlined online bookings via HotDoc. Practitioners are backed by an exceptional team of experienced nursing and administrative staff, providing dedicated support for Chronic Disease Management (CDM) and complex clinical procedures. This highly educational and modern environment offers diverse special interest opportunities and robust CPD support, alongside rewarding supervisor opportunities for experienced doctors looking to mentor registrars or peers. 

 Recognizing the essential need for a strong work-life balance, the clinic provides highly flexible working arrangements tailored to individual lifestyle needs. Situated in a highly sought-after, moratorium-friendly DPA/MM2 location, this position is ideal for VR GPs subject to 19AB restrictions who still wish to remain in close proximity to the metropolitan center. 

 Located just 40 minutes from the Melbourne CBD, Mambourin is a booming, master-planned community nestled within Melbourne's thriving southwestern growth corridor. The area offers an unparalleled lifestyle for families and professionals alike, characterized by rapid population growth and massive infrastructure investments, including brand-new schools, picturesque parks, shopping hubs, and excellent transport links. This position presents the perfect blend of long-term stability, rapid patient base growth, and access to high-quality suburban amenities, making it an ideal place to call home.   Apply Now
